Sound Familiar?

Most online store owners in Manitoba who look for an e-commerce bookkeeper say one of these.

"My deposits never match my sales."

Shopify Payments, PayPal, Stripe and Amazon each pay out on their own schedule, minus fees and refunds. Nothing lines up.

"I sell a lot. Am I making money?"

Revenue looks good. But after cost of goods, shipping, returns and platform fees, you have no idea what each product earns.

"I ship to Ontario and BC. What tax do I charge?"

Out-of-province orders can mean GST/HST at the buyer's province rate, and maybe PST registration somewhere else.

"Meta and Google ads eat my profit."

Ad spend goes up every month. You can't tell which sales it actually paid for.

"Inventory is a guess."

Stock bought from overseas, duties and freight on top. Your cost of goods sold is a number you hope is close.

"It started as a side hustle."

Now it's a real business. Your spreadsheet and shoebox of receipts can't keep up anymore.

E-Commerce Bookkeeping FAQ

Do you do Shopify bookkeeping?

Yes. We reconcile Shopify sales against Shopify Payments, PayPal and Stripe payouts, so fees, refunds and chargebacks are recorded, not lost. We do the same for WooCommerce stores.

Can you help Amazon and Etsy sellers in Canada?

Yes. Amazon and Etsy payouts include many fees and adjustments. We split each payout into sales, fees, refunds and tax, so your books show what really happened.

What sales tax do I charge customers in other provinces?

In general, GST/HST on goods shipped to another province follows the customer's province, not yours. Some provinces can also require you to register for their PST. The rules depend on your sales, so we check your situation on the call.

Do Etsy sellers have to pay taxes?

Yes. Income from an Etsy shop is business income and goes on your tax return, even as a side hustle. Good books let you claim your costs, like materials, shipping and fees.

Can you track inventory and cost of goods sold?

Yes. We record your stock purchases, freight and import duties as part of your cost of goods sold. That is how you see your real margin per product.

How much does ecommerce bookkeeping cost in Canada?

Our Bookkeeping plan is $299/month for less than 100 monthly transactions. Bookkeeping & Tax is $499/month and adds tax filing. Busy stores often have more transactions, so Jennifer gives you a fixed quote on the call.

Do you only work with Winnipeg stores?

Our bookkeepers are in-house and located in Manitoba, near Winnipeg. We do online store bookkeeping for sellers across Manitoba.
